HK001.notes: International and other non-JUPAS applicants apply directly to HKU. A student visa is required for non-locals. Verify the current non-JUPAS guide; do not treat this summary as a deadline.

HK002.language_requirements: Bilingual environment; many programmes are English-medium; Chinese is used in some arts and education tracks.
HK002.notes: Local HKDSE applicants apply through JUPAS. Check faculty-specific language and subject requirements.

HK003.notes: Local HKDSE applicants apply through JUPAS.

HK008.typical_timeline: See the current EdUHK international / non-JUPAS admissions calendar.
HK008.language_requirements: English and Chinese used depending on the programme.
HK008.notes: Verify programme-specific language and admissions requirements.

HK011.notes: Self-financing private university. Confirm the current application process on the official site.

HK012.typical_timeline: See the current Hong Kong Chu Hai College admissions calendar.

JP001.pathway_name: 一般選抜 (Common Test + 第2次学力試験) / 学校推薦型選抜
JP001.exams_required: 一般: 大学入学共通テスト + UTokyo second-stage faculty exams (文科・理科各類). 学校推薦型: recommendation + documents/interview as per faculty. Extremely selective.
JP001.typical_timeline: Common Test mid-Jan; second stage late Feb; recommendation earlier (autumn). April intake.
JP001.language_requirements: Japanese (instruction and exams). English as Common Test / second-stage subject as required.
JP001.notes: All domestic UG enter via College of Arts and Sciences (Komaba) then advance to faculties. Confirm 募集要項 yearly.

JP001.pathway_name: PEAK English UG (final intake Sept 2026) / other English offerings in transition
JP001.exams_required: PEAK: IB / A-Level / Abitur / Baccalauréat / European Baccalaureate or 12-year foreign HS + programme documents; EJU NOT required for PEAK. Standardized tests per PEAK Application Guidelines. NOTE: PEAK admissions end with September 2026 enrollment; UTokyo is transitioning English UG offerings — check welcome.adm.u-tokyo.ac.jp for successors.
JP001.typical_timeline: PEAK: typically Nov–Dec application for following September entry (2026 cycle closed Dec 2025). Future English routes TBD by university.
JP001.language_requirements: PEAK: English medium. Strong academic English expected. Japanese not required for PEAK entry.
JP001.notes: Do not apply to PEAK and other UTokyo UG exams simultaneously. After PEAK ends, monitor new English-programme announcements.

JP001.pathway_name: 外国学校卒業学生特別選考 第1種（私費留学生）
JP001.exams_required: EJU required: 文科各類 = Japanese + Japan and the World (総合) + Math Course 1; 理科各類 = Japanese + Science (2 of Physics/Chemistry/Biology) + Math Course 2. EJU may be taken in Japanese or English for non-Japanese subjects. Also TOEFL iBT or IELTS. Then document screening → essay exam → interview. No published minimum EJU/TOEFL floors.
JP001.typical_timeline: EJU Jun and/or Nov of prior year accepted (e.g. for 2027 entry: Jun/Nov 2026). Apply ~Dec; 1st results Jan; essay Feb; interview/results Mar; April intake.
JP001.language_requirements: Japanese-medium instruction after entry. High Japanese needed for exams and coursework. English scores also submitted.
JP001.notes: Main Japanese-taught path for privately financed internationals. See u-tokyo.ac.jp 外国学校卒業学生特別選考 Q&A.

JP001.pathway_name: 外国学校卒業学生特別選考 第2種（帰国生徒）
JP001.exams_required: EJU NOT required. TOEFL iBT or IELTS required. Document screening → academic exam (Feb) → interview (Mar). Dual Japanese nationals / permanent residents who finished foreign HS typically use 第2種 (not 第1種).
JP001.typical_timeline: Apply ~Nov; 1st results Jan; exams Feb; interview/results Mar; April intake. Guidelines usually published in July.
JP001.language_requirements: Selection and first two years taught mainly in Japanese — solid Japanese expected at application. English scores used in screening.
JP001.notes: Eligibility: typically foreign HS graduates within ~2 years. Faculty assignment for years 3–4 via 進学選択. Cannot hold concurrent PEAK/general applications.

JP002.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 特色入試（総合型・学校推薦型相当）
JP002.exams_required: 共通テスト + Kyoto second-stage exams by faculty. 特色入試 for limited seats (documents/interview/faculty tasks).
JP002.typical_timeline: Common Test mid-Jan; second stage late Feb; 特色 earlier. April intake.
JP002.notes: Highly selective national. Faculty subject sets vary widely.

JP002.pathway_name: Kyoto iUP (International Undergraduate Program) English-track + foundation
JP002.exams_required: Kyoto iUP: international qualifications (IB/A-Level/foreign HS) + TOEFL/IELTS; document screening; EJU accepted as supplementary in some cycles (English or Japanese). Check current iUP Application Guidelines (Oct enrollment).
JP002.typical_timeline: iUP often targets October enrollment; applications typically many months ahead (see iup.kyoto-u.ac.jp).
JP002.language_requirements: iUP: English for early years with intensive Japanese; later years may include Japanese-taught content. English proficiency required at entry.
JP002.notes: Primary English UG route. Most faculties remain Japanese-medium via other paths.

JP002.pathway_name: 私費外国人留学生入試 (faculty-dependent) / Japanese-taught via EJU
JP002.exams_required: EJU subjects as designated by faculty + Kyoto exams/interview where required; TOEFL/IELTS often also needed. Confirm per faculty 募集要項.
JP002.typical_timeline: EJU Jun/Nov; university exams typically winter for April intake.
JP002.notes: Not all faculties run the same international track every year — verify faculty page.

JP002.pathway_name: 外国学校出身者選考 (limited faculties)
JP002.exams_required: As of recent cycles: Law and Economics run 外国学校出身者選考 — Japanese exams/interview + TOEFL iBT; EJU typically NOT used. Other faculties: use general entrance or iUP.
JP002.typical_timeline: Faculty-specific calendars; often autumn–winter for April intake.
JP002.notes: Narrower returnee footprint than Todai/Waseda — check Law/Economics 教務掛 pages.

JP003.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 推薦・総合型 (Science Tokyo)
JP003.exams_required: 共通テスト + Science Tokyo (ex-Tokyo Tech / TMDU merger) faculty exams. STEM-heavy subject sets.
JP003.typical_timeline: Common Test mid-Jan; second stage Feb–Mar; April intake.
JP003.notes: Institute of Science Tokyo — confirm merged admissions branding on admissions.isct.ac.jp / titech legacy pages.

JP003.pathway_name: GSEP (Global Scientists and Engineers Program) English UG
JP003.exams_required: GSEP Bachelor of Engineering: international HS quals + English proficiency + standardised tests/documents per Application Guide; interview possible. EJU not the primary GSEP path.
JP003.typical_timeline: Programme-specific rounds (often autumn for following April/Oct — check current GSEP guide).
JP003.notes: Flagship English UG for Science Tokyo. Japanese-taught faculties use EJU path.

JP003.exams_required: EJU (typically Japanese + Science 2 subjects + Math Course 2) + university exams/interview as required; English test may be added.
JP003.typical_timeline: EJU Jun/Nov; winter university exams for April intake.

JP003.pathway_name: 帰国生徒・外国学校出身者選抜 (if offered) / GSEP / general
JP003.exams_required: Check Science Tokyo undergraduate admissions for returnee quota; else GSEP (English) or general 共通テスト path.
JP003.language_requirements: Japanese for Japanese tracks; English for GSEP
JP003.notes: Post-merger guides supersede separate Tokyo Tech/TMDU returnee pages — verify annually.

JP004.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 学校推薦型 / 総合型
JP004.exams_required: 共通テスト + Osaka faculty second-stage; recommendation/AO where offered.

JP004.pathway_name: 学部英語コース / 国際科学特別入試 (English UG options)
JP004.exams_required: Human Sciences English course (iUDP) and International Science special admission: documents + English proficiency; international quals accepted. EJU not primary for these English tracks.
JP004.typical_timeline: Programme-specific; some Sept entry. See iudp.hus.osaka-u.ac.jp and sci.osaka-u.ac.jp IUPS.
JP004.language_requirements: English for English courses; later years in International Science may shift toward Japanese.
JP004.notes: English UG is limited relative to full faculty set.

JP004.pathway_name: 私費外国人留学生特別入試
JP004.exams_required: EJU (faculty-specific subjects/score floors for application eligibility at some faculties) + Osaka exams; TOEFL often required. MyBest TOEFL not accepted per FAQ. Returnee track does NOT use EJU.
JP004.typical_timeline: EJU Jun/Nov; applications winter for April intake.
JP004.language_requirements: Japanese-medium exams and classes for this track.
JP004.notes: Check faculty 募集要項 for EJU score floors (application thresholds ≠ automatic pass).

JP004.exams_required: Typically ≥2 continuous years of foreign-system schooling; documents + exams/interview. EJU NOT used. English courses available separately.
JP004.typical_timeline: Autumn–winter for April; graduation by 31 Mar usually required for April entry.
JP004.notes: See Osaka 帰国生徒特別入試 FAQ PDF for yearly rules.

JP005.exams_required: 共通テスト + Tohoku second-stage; recommendation/AO limited.

FGL courses (e.g. Advanced Molecular Chemistry, IMAC-U, Applied Marine Biology): international quals + English proficiency; EJU science/math subjects accepted in Japanese or English as listed per course (typically Math Course 2 + Physics/Chemistry ± Biology). Document screening + interview.
JP005.typical_timeline: Often Oct–Jan windows for following enrollment — see insc.tohoku.ac.jp FGL Application Guide.

JP005.exams_required: EJU subjects per faculty + university exam/interview; English test may be required.
JP005.typical_timeline: EJU Jun/Nov; winter exams for April.
JP005.notes: Use FGL instead when seeking English instruction.

JP005.exams_required: Faculty returnee quotas (documents/exams) or FGL English route for international-curriculum students.
JP005.language_requirements: Japanese or English depending on track
JP005.notes: Confirm 帰国生徒要項 on Tohoku admissions site.

JP006.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 推薦・総合型

JP006.exams_required: G30: country-specific qualifications + English (IELTS Academic 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 or post-Jan-2026 scale 4.0 / Duolingo 110 typical minima) + recommended standardised tests. EJU optional as extra evidence, not required. Document screening ± interview.
JP006.notes: Primary English UG at Nagoya. Japanese faculties via EJU.

JP006.pathway_name: 私費外国人留学生入試 (Japanese-taught)

JP006.exams_required: Faculty returnee exams or G30 English admissions.

JP007.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 推薦・総合型
IUPE — International Undergraduate Programs in Engineering (English)
JP007.exams_required: IUPE (EECS, Applied Chemistry, Mechanical/Aerospace, Civil, etc.): English proficiency (e.g. TOEFL iBT 80 / new scale 4.0 or IELTS Academic 6.5, or ≥4 years English-medium secondary) + programme-specific standardised test scores + documents. See Engineering IUPE Application Instructions.
JP007.typical_timeline: Programme rounds for Oct/April entry — kyushu-u.ac.jp Engineering international UG pages.
JP007.notes: Main English UG engineering path at Kyushu.

JP007.exams_required: EJU + faculty exams for Japanese-medium schools.
Returnee special admission where offered, or IUPE for English-curriculum students.

JP008.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 推薦・総合型
Modern Japanese Studies Program (MJSP) and other English UG
JP008.exams_required: MJSP and related English programmes: international HS quals + English proficiency; document screening. EJU not primary for English tracks.
JP008.notes: Also Integrated Science Program etc. — check hokudai international admissions.

JP008.pathway_name: 帰国生徒入試 / English programmes
JP008.exams_required: Returnee quotas and/or MJSP-style English admissions.

JP009.pathway_name: 一般入試 / 共通テスト利用 / 推薦・総合型 (学部別)
JP009.exams_required: Waseda own exams and/or 共通テスト利用入試; AO/recommendation common. Highly competitive for popular schools.
JP009.typical_timeline: AO summer–autumn; general exams Jan–Mar; April intake primary; some Sept.
JP009.notes: Each undergraduate school has distinct 募集要項.

JP009.pathway_name: SILS AO (April Overseas / September) and other English-degree programmes
JP009.exams_required: SILS: document screening + essays; standardised tests (SAT/ACT/IB/A-Level) mandatory for AO April Overseas & September from 2026 intake onwards; English proficiency scores; interview only if required. No published minimum GPA/SAT/IB/English floors (competitive averages published). EJU not mandatory for SILS. Other English programmes (e.g. Political Science & Economics English, Science & Engineering English) have own guides.
JP009.typical_timeline: SILS AO Sept: early Jan + regular Jan–Feb; AO April Overseas: Aug–Sep prior year. Multiple English-degree calendars via Waseda International Admissions Office.
JP009.language_requirements: SILS: English-medium degree; Japanese courses available. English proficiency expected.
JP009.notes: SILS seats e.g. ~100 April Overseas + ~150 September (check current guide). Pre-arrival admission possible.

JP009.pathway_name: 日本語学位プログラム向け私費外国人留学生入試 (学部別)
JP009.exams_required: Many Japanese-taught schools use EJU ± Waseda exams/JLPT. Subject sets per school. SILS does not require EJU.
JP009.typical_timeline: EJU Jun/Nov aligned to school deadlines.
JP009.notes: Do not confuse SILS English AO with Japanese-school EJU tracks.

JP009.pathway_name: 帰国生入試 / SILS AO (Domestic or Overseas)
JP009.exams_required: School-specific 帰国生入試 (documents/essays/interviews ± tests). Returnees from Japanese HS → SILS AO April Domestic / September; from foreign HS → AO April Overseas / September.
JP009.typical_timeline: Often earlier than general entrance; SILS per AO calendar above.
JP009.notes: Popular returnee destination. Verify each school's 帰国生要項.

JP010.pathway_name: 一般入試 / 推薦・AO (学部別)
JP010.exams_required: Keio faculty exams; some 共通テスト利用; AO/FIT etc. by faculty.
JP010.typical_timeline: AO earlier; general Feb–Mar; April intake. PEARL is September.

JP010.pathway_name: PEARL (Economics English, September) + other English tracks
JP010.exams_required: PEARL: IB Diploma (or predicted) OR SAT (ACT no longer accepted from Sept 2027 entry) PLUS TOEFL iBT and/or IELTS Academic (required even for English-medium HS graduates); statement of purpose + mandatory 2-minute video; documents only — no interview. IB and SAT treated equally. Quota ~100 across 3 application periods.
JP010.typical_timeline: Sept 2027 example periods: (I) Oct–Dec, (II) Dec–Jan, (III) Feb–Apr (JST). Application fee JPY 35,000. Guidebook on keio.ac.jp PEARL pages.
JP010.language_requirements: PEARL: English-medium BA Economics. TOEFL/IELTS mandatory for all.
JP010.notes: Also check GIGA (SFC) and other English offerings. Superscoring not accepted.

JP010.pathway_name: 私費外国人留学生入試 (Japanese-taught faculties)
JP010.exams_required: Faculty-dependent; often EJU and/or Keio exams + Japanese proficiency. PEARL does not use EJU.

JP010.pathway_name: 帰国生対象入学試験 (Economics, Law, Medicine, Science & Technology)
JP010.exams_required: Documents (incl. SAT/IB/TOEFL-IELTS as specified) → essay + interview (2nd stage). SFC 総合政策・環境情報 帰国生募集停止 from 2026/2027 onward — use other routes. PEARL also open to returnees via English docs path.
JP010.typical_timeline: Web entry often early July window for following April (check yearly 募集要項). PEARL = Sept calendar above.
JP010.language_requirements: Japanese faculties: Japanese essays/interviews. PEARL: English.
JP010.notes: keio.ac.jp 帰国生対象入学試験. Medicine scholarship notes change by year.

JP011.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 推薦・総合型
JP011.exams_required: 共通テスト + Tsukuba second-stage / recommendation.

JP011.pathway_name: English UG programmes (e.g. Interdisciplinary Engineering, Life & Environmental, etc.)
JP011.exams_required: International quals + English proficiency; document/interview per programme guide. EJU optional/not primary for English tracks.
JP011.notes: See Tsukuba international undergraduate admissions portal.

JP011.pathway_name: 帰国生徒入試 / English programmes
JP011.exams_required: Returnee special selection and/or English UG document routes.

JP012.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 推薦・総合型

JP012.exams_required: International quals + English scores for English programmes; otherwise Japanese track.
JP012.notes: Fewer full English UG seats than Todai/Waseda — verify current list.

JP012.pathway_name: 私費外国人留学生入試 via EJU

JP012.exams_required: Documents + exams/interview; EJU usually not required.

JP013.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 推薦・総合型
IGS (Integrated Global Studies) English UG + other
JP013.exams_required: IGS: international quals + English proficiency; document screening. EJU not primary for IGS.
JP013.notes: Flagship Hiroshima English liberal-arts style programme.

JP013.exams_required: Returnee quotas or IGS English route.

JP014.exams_required: 共通テスト + Hitotsubashi second-stage (commerce/econ/law/social sciences focus).

JP014.pathway_name: Limited English UG; IB/foreign quals mainly via foreign-school / international selections
JP014.exams_required: Few fully English UG seats. International quals may support 外国学校出身者 or English-course applications where offered — check yearly guides. Strong Japanese usually essential for main faculties.
JP014.notes: Not a primary English-degree destination vs Waseda/Keio/Sophia.

JP014.pathway_name: 私費外国人留学生選抜
JP014.exams_required: EJU Japanese + Japan and the World + Math Course 1 with published combined score floor (historically ≥680 — verify current 要項) + TOEFL iBT (historically ≥48 floor) + Hitotsubashi Japanese exam. Competitive far above floors.
JP014.typical_timeline: EJU Jun/Nov; university process winter–spring for April.
JP014.language_requirements: High Japanese; English TOEFL also required.

JP014.exams_required: For Japanese nationals/PRs with overseas schooling (often final ≥2 years abroad). English + essay exams then interview. EJU NOT required. IB obtained overseas can support eligibility when other conditions met.
JP014.typical_timeline: See yearly 外国学校出身者選抜募集要項 (juken.hit-u.ac.jp).
JP014.notes: Distinct from 私費外国人 path.

JP015.pathway_name: 一般 / 共通テスト利用 / 推薦・AO
JP015.exams_required: Ritsumeikan exams ± 共通テスト; extensive AO/recommendation.
JP015.typical_timeline: Multiple rounds; April primary; some Sept.

JP015.pathway_name: English-taught UG (e.g. International Relations, Information Science & Engineering English, etc.)
JP015.exams_required: IB/A-Level/SAT/foreign diploma + English proficiency; document AO. EJU not required for English programmes.
JP015.notes: Sister APU (JP021) is the highest-international-ratio Ritsumeikan Group school.

JP015.pathway_name: 日本語基盤私費外国人入試
JP015.exams_required: EJU ± university exams for Japanese-taught colleges.
Returnee special exams and English-programme AO both common.

JP016.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 学校推薦型 / 総合型
JP016.exams_required: 大学入学共通テスト + Tokyo Medical and Dental University (legacy; now part of Science Tokyo health side) faculty second-stage exams; recommendation/AO where offered.
JP016.typical_timeline: Common Test mid-Jan; second stage ~Feb–Mar; 推薦/総合型 earlier. April intake.
JP016.notes: Tokyo Medical and Dental University (legacy; now part of Science Tokyo health side) — national university. Faculty subject sets vary; medicine/education tracks especially selective.

JP016.pathway_name: Limited English UG; international quals mainly via special/IB routes or Japanese track
JP016.exams_required: IB/A-Level/foreign HS diploma may support eligibility, but most faculties remain Japanese-medium. Check for any English programmes on university site. Otherwise use EJU path.
JP016.typical_timeline: If English programme exists: programme calendar. Else n/a for English UG.
JP016.language_requirements: Japanese typically required for mainstream faculties.
JP016.notes: Medicine/dentistry highly Japanese-dependent; English UG rare. Prefer Science Tokyo (JP003) GSEP for English engineering; health faculties need Japanese.

JP016.pathway_name: 私費外国人留学生入試 via EJU
JP016.exams_required: EJU Japanese + Science + Math Course 2 typical; extreme Japanese proficiency for medicine/dentistry. University exams + interviews.
JP016.typical_timeline: EJU Jun/Nov; university exams typically winter for April intake.
JP016.language_requirements: Japanese (academic); English test may be additional.
JP016.notes: Tokyo Medical and Dental University (legacy; now part of Science Tokyo health side) Japanese-taught international path. Confirm faculty 募集要項 / JASSO EJU-use list.

JP016.pathway_name: 帰国生徒特別入試 (if offered) / general / English programme
JP016.exams_required: Returnee medical seats extremely limited; Japanese exams dominate.
JP016.typical_timeline: Often autumn–winter for April intake; earlier than general entrance.
JP016.notes: Tokyo Medical and Dental University (legacy; now part of Science Tokyo health side): eligibility definitions are faculty-specific — read 帰国生徒要項.

JP017.pathway_name: 一般 / 共通テスト利用 / 推薦・総合型
JP017.exams_required: TUS own science/math-heavy exams ± 共通テスト.

JP017.pathway_name: Limited English UG; mainly Japanese tracks
JP017.exams_required: Few full English bachelor routes — check current international programme list. International quals alone rarely replace Japanese-track exams.

JP017.pathway_name: 私費外国人留学生入試 via EJU
JP017.exams_required: EJU (Japanese + Science + Math Course 2 typical for STEM) ± TUS exams.

JP018.pathway_name: 一般選抜 / 推薦・総合型

JP018.exams_required: Some English offerings; otherwise Japanese track.
Documents + exams; EJU usually not required.

JP019.pathway_name: 一般 / 推薦・AO (日本語学部)
Faculty of Liberal Arts (FLA) English UG
JP019.exams_required: First-year: SAT (R&W+Math) or ACT (incl. Writing) or full IB Diploma (6 subjects; certificate not OK) or 3 GCE A-Levels; plus TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic (Home Edition/Online/ITP/Indicator/MyBest not accepted). English test waiver if ≥5 of last 6 years English-medium instruction. Two essays + 2 recommendations + transcripts. No published minimum SAT/IB scores. Abitur not accepted as standardised substitute.
JP019.typical_timeline: Multiple FLA periods (spring/autumn entry) — see adm.sophia.ac.jp FLA When and How to Apply. Scores ≤2 years old for SAT.
JP019.language_requirements: FLA: English-medium liberal arts. TOEFL/IELTS unless waiver.
JP019.notes: Institution codes: TOEFL/SAT 0819; ACT 5575. Other English programmes (SPSFS etc.) have own guides.

JP019.pathway_name: 日本語学位課程の外国人入試
JP019.exams_required: EJU and/or Sophia Japanese exams for Japanese-taught faculties. FLA does not use EJU.
Japanese faculties: returnee special admission (documents/exams). English-curriculum returnees often use FLA.

JP020.pathway_name: 一般選抜 (4区分) / 推薦・総合型
JP020.exams_required: General: Humanities/Social OR Math/Natural sciences track; bilingual interview option; English external-test option. ICU Admissions Office exams + documents.
JP020.typical_timeline: Multiple rounds; April primary; some Sept English-based.
JP020.notes: Liberal arts single college (Arts and Sciences).

JP020.pathway_name: English Language Based Admissions (April/September, Type A/B)
JP020.exams_required: Documents in English + IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 79 (tests on/after 21 Jan 2026: TOEFL ≥4.5 on new scale). Type B may include online interview. IB/A-Level/foreign diploma welcomed. EJU NOT required for this path.
JP020.typical_timeline: April Type A/B: apps often Oct; Sept entry: later rounds (see ICU EN admissions). Guides posted mid-year.
JP020.language_requirements: English screening; Japanese Language Program (JLP) usually required after entry unless high English elects JLP vs ELA rules.
JP020.notes: No Japanese proficiency required at English-based application. icu.ac.jp/en/admissions.

JP020.pathway_name: 総合型選抜 EJU利用 (4月/9月)
JP020.exams_required: EJU in Japanese: (Japanese + Japan&World + Math 1 or 2) OR (Japanese + Math 2 + Science 2 subjects). Plus IELTS or TOEFL (no minimum; recency rules). Document screening + interview. Foreign-system schooling years required (see 要項; often 6 continuous years abroad for this category).
JP020.typical_timeline: Example April cycle: apply early Dec; exam/interview Feb; results late Feb. Check icu.ac.jp EJU page.
JP020.language_requirements: Japanese EJU subjects; English score also submitted.
JP020.notes: Distinct from English Language Based Admissions.

JP020.pathway_name: 総合型選抜 帰国生 (4月入学)
JP020.exams_required: ≥2 continuous years foreign secondary schooling; finish 12-year curriculum in window (e.g. Apr 2025–Mar 2027 for 2027 entry). Documents + 2 recommendations + IELTS/TOEFL iBT/Cambridge English. 1st: documents; 2nd: online Japanese interview. Quota example: 35. ELA vs JLP language track depends on English scores at application.
JP020.typical_timeline: Web apply early July; docs by early Aug; interview mid-Sep; April enrollment. Eligibility pre-check deadline ~June.
JP020.language_requirements: Interview in Japanese; English scores required. Bilingual education after entry.
JP020.notes: icu.ac.jp 帰国生 page. Very popular with returnees.

JP115.typical_timeline: 2026 example: Intl I April — online apps Oct; Intl II Sept — Jan–Feb apps. Separate guides yearly.

JP_SYSTEM.pathway_name: 国内一般選抜 / 学校推薦型選抜 / 総合型選抜 (national norms)
JP_SYSTEM.exams_required: 一般選抜: 大学入学共通テスト (National Center Test successor) + university/faculty second-stage exams (many nationals/publics; many privates use own exams ± Common Test). 学校推薦型: school recommendation + documents/interview/small tests. 総合型選抜 (ex-AO): essays, activities, interviews, sometimes subject tests.
JP_SYSTEM.typical_timeline: 総合型: often summer–autumn of final HS year. 推薦: autumn. 一般: Common Test mid-January; university exams late Jan–March. Main matriculation April.
JP_SYSTEM.language_requirements: Japanese (instruction and almost all entrance exams). English appears as a Common Test / faculty subject, not as medium of instruction for most programmes.
JP_SYSTEM.notes: Applies to students educated primarily in the Japanese school system. Medicine/dentistry/veterinary/pharmacy often 6-year programmes with extra selectivity. Exact subject sets are faculty-specific.

JP_SYSTEM.pathway_name: International qualifications / English-taught degree programmes / direct document admission
JP_SYSTEM.exams_required: IB Diploma, GCE A-Level, Abitur, Baccalauréat, SAT/ACT (where accepted), or foreign high school diploma meeting MEXT 12-year (or equivalent) rule. Programme-specific: TOEFL iBT / IELTS; essays; interviews; sometimes SAT subject or internal tests. EJU usually NOT required for fully English-taught UG tracks.
JP_SYSTEM.typical_timeline: Often autumn–winter applications for April and/or September/October entry. English programmes frequently offer September/October intake alongside or instead of April.
JP_SYSTEM.language_requirements: English-taught UG: typically TOEFL iBT ~71–80+ or IELTS ~5.5–6.0 as a Study in Japan guideline floor; selective programmes often TOEFL 90–100+. Japanese not always required at entry but helpful for daily life.
JP_SYSTEM.notes: MEXT recognises IB/A-Level/etc. as university admission qualifications, but each university still runs its own selection. Best fit: PEAK/PEARL/SILS/FLA/ICU/APU/G30-type programmes. Always read the programme Application Guide.

JP_SYSTEM.pathway_name: Examination for Japanese University Admission for International Students (EJU) pathway
JP_SYSTEM.exams_required: EJU subjects as designated by the university/faculty: Japanese as a Foreign Language (0–450 incl. writing); Science (2 of Physics/Chemistry/Biology) OR Japan and the World; Mathematics Course 1 or 2. Many schools also require their own exam and/or interview; some require TOEFL/IELTS in addition (EJU has no English section).
JP_SYSTEM.typical_timeline: EJU offered twice yearly (e.g. 2026: 21 Jun and 8 Nov). Align the session the university designates. University exams/interviews often follow for April intake (applications typically autumn–winter). Some schools offer pre-arrival admission based mainly on EJU.
JP_SYSTEM.language_requirements: Japanese-taught programmes: strong academic Japanese — Study in Japan cites JLPT N1/N2 and EJU Japanese ≥~250 as a general floor; competitive faculties expect substantially higher. Exam language for Science/Math/Japan&World may be Japanese or English per university rule.
JP_SYSTEM.notes: EJU is a score report, not a pass/fail gate. Hundreds of universities 'use EJU' but subject sets, score floors, and whether a second exam is required vary. Check JASSO 'universities using EJU' list and the faculty 募集要項. Not typically used for returnee special admissions.

JP_SYSTEM.pathway_name: 帰国生徒・帰国子女特別入試 (returnee special admission)
JP_SYSTEM.exams_required: Proof of overseas schooling (often ≥1–2 continuous years abroad, return within a defined window — university-specific) + documents, essays, interviews; sometimes SAT/IB/TOEFL; sometimes faculty written exams. EJU usually NOT required for returnee tracks. Returnees may instead use general entrance (Common Test) or English programmes.
JP_SYSTEM.typical_timeline: Often earlier than general entrance (autumn–winter). April intake dominant; some English programmes also September.
JP_SYSTEM.language_requirements: Japanese-taught returnee exams: Japanese essay/interview common. English-programme route: English scores. Many returnees are bilingual and choose the stronger language track.
JP_SYSTEM.notes: Eligibility definitions (years abroad, passport/residency, years since return) differ sharply by university — never assume a national standard. Popular private destinations historically include Waseda, Keio, Sophia, ICU; many nationals also run 帰国生徒枠. IB holders may use either returnee or IB/AO pathways.
